source.quote: 10,813,138,306 shares of common stock, par value $0.01 per share, outstanding as of October 21, 2026

notes: One class of common stock, listed on Nasdaq as AMZN. The 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 (filed October 30, 2026) has the latest count; the FY2025 10-K cover (10,734,920,870 at January 28, 2026) is older.
